- CommandSpec removed; new command builder is org.spongepowered.api.command.Command with Command.Parameterized.
- Player class replaced by ServerPlayer in org.spongepowered.api.entity.living.player.server.

- Update imports to new packages and classes.
- Change execute signature to use CommandCause and new CommandContext.
- Retrieve ServerPlayer from CommandCause (using cause.first(ServerPlayer.class)).
- Adjust sendMessage to use cause.audience(), aligning with Adventure.
- Update buildSpec to return Command.Parameterized using Command.builder().

These minimal edits keep functionality equivalent while aligning with the new API.
